protocol.slot_code: frozen Level 6.19 independent all-slot Memory probe

intervention.location: final block MemoryAttention, final query only
intervention.mechanism: add log(odds) to selected slot attention logits
intervention.selection: per-example correct-label versus frozen deployed-rival contribution under the frozen Level 6.19 Memory probe

equal_dose_controls.cross_example_roll: another batch example's top four slots at odds 4
equal_dose_controls.random: 4 independent random four-slot controls at odds 4

positive_control.dose: per-example L2 norm matched to top4 odds-4 context change

protocol.primary_population: source errors whose frozen Memory probe is correct
primary_behavior_family: the same four contrasts using deployed correctness

decision_rule.context_specificity: all four context-margin estimates positive with Holm p < 0.05
decision_rule.behavior_specificity: all four deployed-correctness estimates positive with Holm p < 0.05

diagnosis.registered_next_boundary: The downstream path responds to equal-dose context improvement, but linear-probe slot targeting is not a sufficient read mechanism.
